The record genuinely supplies sourceObj/targetObj : C.Obj, sourceSpectrum/targetSpectrum : SpectrumObject and morphism : SpectrumMorphism sourceSpectrum targetSpectrum. No actual carrier map is erased or treated as only a label.

sourceSpectrum and targetSpectrum have defaults F.presheaf.obj sourceObj/targetObj. These defaults may be overridden; they are not fields proving equalities of the selected spectra to the presheaf assignments. No missing equality, naturality or functor law is inferred.

The exact SpectrumObject provider was fully read: it has a carrier, arbitrary suspension function, degree-indexed homotopyGroup types and independent stable Prop with proof. SpectrumMorphism has an actual carrier map and independent preservesStableStructure Prop with proof, without a stated suspension or homotopy-group compatibility equation.

The exact SheafOfSpectra provider was fully read: its presheaf carries object data and restriction morphisms; descent/hyperdescent/homotopyCoherent are independent named propositions, not definitions of descent or coherence laws in that source.

fredholmAnalogue and diracType are independently supplied Prop fields with certified witnesses. Both source theorems are genuine conditional proof projections under full C/J/F/D, but neither defines finite-dimensional kernel/cokernel, ellipticity, a Dirac operator equation or an analytic theorem.

The entire mixed own-provider record and its actual typed data/proofs stay exact archival material. Do not drop fields, substitute a simpler spectrum/record, add a legacy self-provider import or claim a pure operator theorem from its labels.
